question: Does Apayao State College's listed 2025 agri-fishery database contain reusable, taxonomically supported, location/date-resolved wild-fish observations relevant to the Luzon freshwater inventory?

source.titleAsPublished: Development of Database Covering Agri – Fishery in the Province of Apayao
source.duplicateInterpretation: The exact title occurs twice in the same completed-research page. The listing does not say whether this is a page duplication or two separate records; treat it as one discovery lead until ASC clarifies.
source.abstractAccess: The official completed-research page links to a 2025 research-abstracts page, but it timed out in the web reader and direct HTTP retrieval returned 403 from this review environment. No abstract text or database download was obtained.

evidenceLimits: The official list provides only a project title; it exposes no abstract, author list, report, data dictionary, schema or public download link for this record.

The title does not establish that its data cover wild fish, taxonomic species observations, specific rivers/lakes, or any date-resolved field surveys. It could instead concern broader agriculture/fisheries administration, production or aquaculture.
No methodology, taxonomic authority, specimen/voucher link, coordinates, locality precision, collection dates, source provenance, update date or reuse license was found in the reviewed page.
The 2025 research list contains the same title at positions 14 and 64; this is not counted as two studies or two independent datasets.
acceptanceRequirements: Project authors/office confirm whether the listed title denotes one project and identify the completed database/report version.
Data dictionary and a sample or export distinguish wild-caught observations from cultured/stocked/aquaculture records and other fishery statistics.
Species names are traceable to an identification authority; uncertain or vernacular-only rows remain explicitly unresolved.
Rows have interpretable observation date, waterbody/locality and spatial precision; coordinates are not guessed from municipality labels.
Provenance, voucher/specimen support where applicable, known sampling bias and separate licensing/permission terms for app display, redistribution and potential commercial use are documented.

disposition.reason: A title-only institutional listing is a useful contact lead, not evidence of fish occurrence or a license. The database contents and rights must be verified before any row is admitted.

nextAction: Add this 2025 project as a separate, explicitly unverified question in the unsent Apayao institutional inquiry. Request project authorship, scope, data dictionary, fish/wild-versus-culture distinction, site/date provenance, taxonomy, access route and item-level reuse terms.

sources.supports: Official 2025 completed-research list, where the title is displayed twice without author or data links.
Official page linked as 2025 Research Abstracts; content could not be retrieved in this review session.
ASC RDE office and current Research & Special Projects director routing.
